Singer Khesari Lal Yadav Meets Family of Murder Victim, Questions Bihar Police

Singer Khesari Lal Yadav met the family of the deceased Bunty Yadav, who was murdered. During his visit, Yadav expressed his condolences to the victim's mother and raised questions about the effectiveness of Bihar Police's prohibition policy, stating that the police are unable to apprehend the real culprits.
